A new game. You play Black, so you move first.

Rules: Chinese area scoring, with 7 points of komi for White; a level score is a draw. Simple ko: an immediate recapture is refused, and the board marks the ko point when there is one. Suicide is not allowed. An invalid move is refused with the rule it broke, and the turn stays with you. The game ends after two passes in a row or a resignation; a game that reaches 243 moves is scored where it stands. After two passes the engine scores the position as it stands and decides itself which stones are dead.

Do not build or use a Go engine, run Monte Carlo, search over sequences of future moves, or write a program that chooses, ranks or recommends moves.

Play until the game is over. The final result comes back from your last Go call, followed by a closing note. Before you end the session after a game, write down in your working directory whatever will help the next session play better. The session ends when you end your turn.

events.text:
I won game 113 as Black against the 14k opponent, by 2 points (B+2) under Chinese scoring with 7 komi. Both players passed at move 65. The count was 45 for me against 36 + 7 for White.

- **Opening:** White copied my C3 and G3 with C7 and G7. In two earlier games with this layout I tried the row-6 answer E6, and both times White kept rows 6–9 and won (by 4 and 6). This time I played move 5 at E7, splitting White's two top stones, and later gave E7 up.
- **The deciding fight:** White pushed a chain of stones (F5, F4, F3, E3, D3 and on to C2/D2) down into my bottom area. I kept my own stones connected (G5, E4, G4, D4, C4) and then filled the chain's liberties from outside with F2, E2, B2, F1 and D1. C1 captured 7 stones, and that won the game.
- **Endgame:** A4 captured nothing directly but it saved the left edge for me. I also took the dead White stones (G1/G2 and J3) off the board before the final pass.

The margin was thin again: White still got the whole top. I've added the game record and these notes to `CLAUDE.md`. The plan for the next game as Black is 14k again with the same E7 idea, moving up to 12k after a second win in a row.
